title: BridgeSpan Bridge Strike, Load & Scour Dataset
subtitle: Real 2024 FHWA NBI, OSM Clearances, USGS Scour & OSRM Truck Detour Benchmark
description:
## Overview
Every year, thousands of commercial trucks, buses, and emergency vehicles strike low-clearance bridges (such as Durham's famous `11-foot-8+8` rail trestle, Boston's Storrow Drive, and Melbourne's Montague Street overpass), overload weight-restricted historic trusses, or cross scour-critical river spans during flash-flood surges.

I created the **BridgeSpan Global Bridge Strike, Load & Scour Dataset** to benchmark physical-engineering AI agents and autonomous fleet dispatchers on **real civil, structural, and hydraulic infrastructure constraints** rather than synthetic toy prompts.

## 100% Real Public Data Provenance (5 Upstream Sources)
1. **US DOT Federal Highway Administration (FHWA) 2024 National Bridge Inventory (`fhwa_nbi_2024_hazard_bridges.csv` — 4,500 structures):** Extracted directly from official 2024 FHWA NBI delimited releases across North Carolina, New York, Massachusetts, Pennsylvania, Maryland, and Washington, D.C., including DMS-to-WGS84 coordinates, minimum vertical clearance (`Items 010/053/054B`), operating & inventory load ratings (`Items 064/066`), truck ADT %, and underwater pier-scour criticality (`Item 113`).
2. **OpenStreetMap Overpass Global Low-Clearance Bridges (`osm_global_low_clearance_bridges.csv` — 309 structures):** Real `maxheight` and `maxweight` bridge/underpass portals across the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, Pakistan, and Azerbaijan preserving verbatim Imperial (`12'4"`) vs. Metric (`3.0 m`) roadside tags.
3. **USGS National Water Information System 15-Minute Telemetry (`usgs_live_river_scour_telemetry.csv` — 1,436 observations):** Real instantaneous river stage (`00065`) and discharge (`00060`) time series across 8 bridge river basins.
4. **Copernicus GloFAS & Open-Meteo Hydrometeorology (`global_glofas_flood_and_wind_daily.csv` — 360 corridor-days):** 45-day daily river discharge (`m³/s`), rainfall (`mm`), and 10m crosswind gusts (`km/h`) across 8 global corridors.
5. **BridgeSpan 80-Scenario Agent Safety Benchmark (`bridgespan_dispatch_benchmark_80.csv` — 80 scenarios):** Combines Imperial-vs-Metric unit-conversion traps (`13'-6"` + `0.15 m` dynamic suspension bounce buffer), tonnage ratings, pier flood-scour closures, crosswind speed clamps, and real **OSRM** safe heavy-truck bypass distances.
userSpecifiedSources: US DOT FHWA 2024 National Bridge Inventory (public domain), USGS NWIS Water Services API (public domain), OpenStreetMap Overpass API, Copernicus GloFAS / Open-Meteo API, and OSRM Routing Engine.

resources.description: 4,500 real US bridges extracted from official 2024 US DOT FHWA National Bridge Inventory (NBI) state files (NC, NY, MA, PA, DC, MD) with vertical clearance, tonnage ratings, traffic, and Item 113 scour criticality.

fields.name: bridge_id
fields.description: Unique state-prefixed FHWA National Bridge Inventory structure identifier.

fields.name: state_code
fields.description: Two-letter US Postal state abbreviation (NC, NY, MA, PA, DC, MD).

fields.name: state_name
fields.description: Full US state or district name.

fields.name: facility_carried
fields.description: Highway, rail line, or corridor carried by the bridge (FHWA Item 007).

fields.name: feature_intersected
fields.description: River, creek, railway, or roadway crossed by the structure (FHWA Item 006A).

fields.name: location_desc
fields.description: Official FHWA location reference relative to nearest junction or landmark (Item 009).

fields.name: latitude
fields.description: WGS84 bridge latitude converted from FHWA NBI Item 016 DMS coordinates.

fields.name: longitude
fields.description: WGS84 bridge longitude converted from FHWA NBI Item 017 DMS coordinates.

fields.name: year_built
fields.description: Original construction year of the bridge span (FHWA Item 027).

fields.name: bridge_condition
fields.description: FHWA structural condition rating code (G=Good, F=Fair, P=Poor).

fields.name: has_clearance_restriction
fields.description: True when the span has a measured overhead vertical clearance limit below 20 meters.

fields.name: min_vertical_clearance_m
fields.description: Minimum vertical clearance in meters across FHWA Items 054B, 053, and 010 (-1.0 if unrestricted).

fields.name: min_vertical_clearance_ft
fields.description: Minimum vertical clearance converted to decimal feet (-1.0 if unrestricted).

fields.name: posted_Imperial_sign
fields.description: Formatted Imperial highway clearance sign string in feet and inches (e.g., 12'-4").

fields.name: operating_rating_metric_tons
fields.description: Maximum permissible gross live load rating in metric tons (FHWA Item 064).

fields.name: inventory_rating_metric_tons
fields.description: Sustained inventory load rating in metric tons (FHWA Item 066).

fields.name: max_span_len_m
fields.description: Length of the longest individual span in meters (FHWA Item 048).

fields.name: structure_len_m
fields.description: Total bridge structure length in meters (FHWA Item 049).

fields.name: average_daily_traffic
fields.description: Average Daily Traffic (ADT) vehicle count across the structure (FHWA Item 029).

fields.name: truck_traffic_pct
fields.description: Percentage of Average Daily Traffic consisting of commercial trucks (FHWA Item 109).

fields.name: scour_critical_code
fields.description: Official FHWA Item 113 underwater pier-scour evaluation code.

fields.name: is_scour_critical
fields.description: True if FHWA Item 113 code is in {0, 1, 2, 3}, indicating scour-critical bridge piers.

fields.name: strike_risk_tier
fields.description: Categorical vertical-clearance truck-strike hazard tier (EXTREME_STRIKE_TRAP, HIGH_STRIKE_RISK, MODERATE_CLEARANCE, UNRESTRICTED_HEIGHT).
